description: A college registrar must decide whether to approve a student's late withdrawal petition for BIO 210 and finalize the effective date, financial adjustment, and record corrections, with input from the instructor, academic counselor, financial aid officer, and disability services coordinator.

shared_context.S1: A student has petitioned to withdraw from BIO 210 after the college's standard withdrawal deadline of October 18, 2025.
shared_context.S2: The student is still listed as enrolled in BIO 210, and the registrar makes the final decision on late-withdrawal petitions.
shared_context.S3: The college can record an approved exception as a W and can make related financial and academic-record adjustments when the required offices confirm them.
shared_context.S4: The registrar's routine petition review includes a check-in with the course instructor, academic counseling, financial aid, and disability services before the decision is finalized.
shared_context.S5: The standard petition-review procedure uses four scheduled speaking slots in this order: course instructor, academic counseling, financial aid, and disability services. At each slot, the registrar calls on that office, the office states its relevant finding and submits its source record to the review log, and the registrar moves to the next slot only after that submission.
shared_context.S6: The registrar closes the petition review only after all four scheduled offices have completed their speaking slots and source-record submissions.

PF1.text: Professor Singh's attendance and assignment records show that the student's last academically engaged date was October 14, 2025; he entered the date in his course notes, but it was not copied into the registrar's petition packet.

PF2.text: Ms. Ortega reviewed the student's hospital discharge documentation, which confirms a medical inability to participate from October 15 through the end of the term; the documentation qualifies the petition for the college's retroactive medical-withdrawal exception, but it has not yet been attached to the petition packet.

PF3.text: Mr. Bell confirmed that processing the petition as a medical withdrawal will produce a 50 percent tuition credit, rather than no credit or a full credit, because the withdrawal falls in the college's documented medical-adjustment window; he recorded this in the aid office file but has not entered it in the student account system.

PF4.text: Ms. Laurent's accommodation log shows that the student had an active extended-time accommodation on October 14, 2025, but the BIO 210 midterm was administered without it; disability services requires the registrar to remove the resulting exam penalty through a grade-record correction when the withdrawal is processed, and this correction request has not yet been filed.

decisions.withdrawal_type: string; use exactly 'retroactive_medical' for the approved medical exception

commitments.type: string; use an action type identifying the required record or documentation action

revealed: fact_id; include every private fact that its owner stated aloud during the review

acceptance_conditions: The late-withdrawal petition must be approved as a retroactive medical withdrawal.
The effective withdrawal date must be October 14, 2025.
The student must receive a 50 percent tuition credit.
A grade-record correction must remove the BIO 210 midterm penalty caused by the missing accommodation.
The approved withdrawal and its supporting medical documentation must be formally recorded.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] in ['file_grade_record_correction', 'file_grade_correction', 'grade_record_correction', 'source_record_filing', 'source_record_attachment', 'record_correction'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] in ['attach_medical_documentation', 'medical_documentation_attachment', 'document_attachment', 'source_record_filing', 'source_record_attachment'] and 'hospital discharge' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The instructor's record changes the effective withdrawal date to exactly October 14, 2025 and supplies the date that must be cited.
The counselor's hospital documentation changes the petition to an approved retroactive_medical withdrawal and adds the exact hospital-discharge documentation commitment.
The financial-aid confirmation changes the tuition adjustment to exactly a 50 percent credit and identifies the amount that must be cited.
The accommodation log changes the required record action to a grade-record-correction commitment removing the BIO 210 midterm penalty.
